title: Patron Supplement on Security Deposits Interest for Long-Standing Capital Credit Members
content:
Members of long standing earn a patron supplement on the rate of the December 31 accrual on their cash Security Deposits deposit. The patron supplement comes from the member's active Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) account.

## Terms

An account opened at least the long patron months of **240** before the last day of the year before the accrued year earns the long patron supplement of **0.15** percentage points; one opened at least the short patron months of **120** but fewer than 240 before that day earns the short patron supplement of **0.05** percentage points; a later account, or none, earns none. The supplement is added to the commission rate of the December 31 accrual, in percentage points.

The opening date and the status are those of the member's Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) account; only an account in active status is read.

## The terms in a table

| Whole months from the active capital credit account's opening to December 31 of the year before the accrued year | Patron supplement |
|---|---|
| 240 or more | 0.15 |
| 120 to 239 | 0.05 |
| fewer than 120 | none |
| the member has no active capital credit account | none |

## Hypothetical illustrations (accrued year 2026, months counted to December 31, 2025)

| Active capital credit account opened | Supplement |
|---|---|
| March 1, 1996 (more than 240 whole months) | 0.15 |
| December 31, 2005 (exactly 240 whole months) | 0.15 |
| January 1, 2006 (239 whole months) | 0.05 |
| June 1, 2018 (fewer than 120 whole months) | none |
